explanation: By the Fredholm alternative (proved inline as linVerifAlt) there is k0 with k0^T M = 0 and k0 . v != 0; rescale to k1 with k1 . v = 1. Then k -> k + (t' - t) k1 is a bijection (inverse k -> k - (t' - t) k1) from the keys with (k^T M, k . v) = (a, t) to those with (a, t'), so Finset.card_nbij' gives equal cardinalities.
